decisions.reason: As a newly launched stand-alone offering with no clear negative market signal, it is still likely to be retained while management waits for clearer evidence relative to aspiration levels.
Its home-page prominence and documented Germany premiere suggest strategic importance and early market traction, so results are likely seen as at least close enough to aspiration to continue.
It appears to be a complementary module in the firm’s finishing portfolio, and with only one year on the market management would usually allow more time before reallocating resources.
The product was highlighted on the home page as a new B2 multifinishing solution, indicating a flagship role that a German wholesale specialist would be unlikely to abandon quickly.
Although only shown on its own page and without reported adoption, the uncertainty is still consistent with keeping it for another year given normal search and learning in capital-equipment markets.
The reported customer installation is a concrete positive outcome, making it likely that management judges the product as sufficiently promising to remain on the market.
